messages:
Kevin (Sales): Quick sync - Medirev legal pushed back: they need an auditable delivery receipt showing logs reached their SIEM + a record that all POC keys were revoked after the trial. They want a signed bundle. Can Hosted cover this or do we need Dedicated?
Nadia (Eng): Hosted yes for logs + key ops. We can stream to Splunk HEC or upload gzipped jsonl to their S3. For proofs we can generate: 1) daily manifest with file sha256, 2) rotation/revoke CSV, 3) signed attestation PDF.
Rob (Security): Add tamper-evidence: include manifest.sha256 and sign the manifest (PKCS7). Attestation should state redaction policy, control owners, and KMS origin (Amazon KMS/HSM). If they insist on CMK ownership, recommend Dedicated/Private.
Sam (SE): Operational note: for cross-account S3 we can create a write-role: arn:aws:iam::MEDIREV:role/RedwoodUploadRole. For Splunk provide HEC endpoint+token. Sample HEC payload we use:
``
POST /services/collector/event/1.0
Authorization: Splunk <TOKEN>
{"event":{"request_id":"req-123","ip":"3.4.5.6","model":"redwood-large"}}
```
poc-bot: Provisioned medirev-poc-03 (expires 2026-05-10) :white_check_mark:
Nadia (Eng): CSV fields for key ops: key_id, op(create|rotate|revoke), actor, ts, job_id, old_hash, new_hash, ticket_ref. Example: key_9,rotate,alice@medirev,2026-03-20T09:12:00Z,job-22,sha256:ab12...,sha256:cd34...,INC-3321
Rob (Security): Also include evidence of deletion: revoke-event id + timestamp + manifest sha. We'll include SOC2 control refs and a short redacted pentest excerpt.
Kevin (Sales): Can we produce the bundle and upload to their S3 (preferred) within 36 hours if they send bucket ARN and role?
Sam (SE): Yes. If they delay we'll upload to our secure SFTP and provide a signed receipt. I'll prepare a README that maps files to questionnaire items and includes egress IPs.
Nadia (Eng): I'll run the export window for the POC dates, generate manifests, and create the signed attestation. Need Medirev point-of-contact and CMK preference (if any).
Kevin (Sales): Carol@medirev.com is the contact. I'll request S3 ARN + write role and confirm they accept signed manifest for tamper evidence. Thanks team :thumbsup:
